title: How a Godly Man Kills the Sin He's Renamed a Guilty Pleasure
caption:
You didn't sin. You just found a softer word for it.

Every man has one: a "guilty pleasure," a "phase," a "stress reliever." The new name doesn't change what it's doing to you. Scripture never learned it.

Colossians 3:5 doesn't say manage it. It says put it to death. Not diet it down. Kill it.

What you rename in private, name out loud to someone.

#godlyman #christianmen #putyoursintodeath #discipline #brotherhood #faithoverfeelings
